$description: CLOSED assetRole vocabulary derived from real usage sites (grep of src/**/*.jsx, src/lib/**, index.html and public/ directories). A generated PageSpec may only use these ids; an unlisted role is invalid.

generationPolicyMeaning.may-generate-new: A generator may create a NEW original asset for this role (generic UI glyphs, abstract background/illustration in the site's style). It must not copy an existing file and must not claim to be Coda's or a third party's original.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-reuse-exact: The asset is Coda's own brand or product asset (logo, favicon, own promo video, flags). A generator may only reference the existing local file by exact path; it must not recreate, redraw, recolour, crop or "improve" it.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-fabricate: The asset depicts real third parties, real people, real payment brands or a real product UI. A generator must never create, redraw, approximate, restyle or AI-render it. Only an exact reference to a file that already exists in public/ is allowed; if the slot needs a different real asset, leave it as a placeholder for a human to supply, with rights confirmed.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-redistribute: The asset is commercially licensed (ABC Monument Grotesk). It may be referenced where it already lives, but must not be regenerated, converted, subset, re-hosted or copied into a new package or generated output.

policyNote: Exactly 4 policies. The brief suggested must-not-reuse-live-endpoint as a 4th; no live endpoint exists in this site (cit-asset-no-remote: no fetch, no forms, no remote URLs), so the evidence-based 4th value is must-not-redistribute (the commercial typeface).
pinnedPolicyMechanism: Every role with complianceCritical=true carries pinnedPolicy equal to its generationPolicy. extraction/verify_all.py check [j] checks generationPolicy == pinnedPolicy for exactly these roles (membership in the 4-value enum is NOT sufficient: may-generate-new is a valid value that would be wrong for every pinned role). It is proven by mutations to a different-but-valid policy in schema/tests/adversarial_test.py and extraction/prove_drift.py.

globalRules.noExternalRequests: All images, fonts and video are local (public/images, public/images/2026-07, public/fonts, public/video, favicon). Generated output must not reference remote URLs. Evidence: cit-asset-no-remote.
globalRules.inertExternalLinks: Links to coda.co pages outside the 15 routes are inert href="#". Evidence: cit-asset-linkguard.
globalRules.realCompany: Real third-party logos, real people's photos or video, real payment-brand marks, real product UI screenshots and the commercial ABC Monument Grotesk typeface must never be reproduced, redrawn, approximated or fabricated by a generator. This design-repo documents where they are used; it does not grant rights to them.
globalRules.noWorldMapOrCountryIllustrationBeyondLis: The brief mentioned world-map/illustration images: only the page-tile map tiles (world-map-illustration) exist.
